title: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT
description: Use ON CONFLICT for upsert patterns.

data.text: ON CONFLICT handles unique or exclusion constraint violations.

data.title: Upsert
data.code:
INSERT INTO users (email, display_name, login_count)
VALUES ($1, $2, 1)
ON CONFLICT (email)
DO UPDATE SET
  display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
  login_count = users.login_count + 1
RETURNING id, login_count;

data.title: CONFLICT
data.text: Specify the constraint or index used for conflict detection.
